# [STORY] As an Admin, I want a 1-click cloud deploy dashboard so that I can spin up the backend and showcase it live on Vercel

## User Story
**As an** Admin / Portfolio Presenter
**I want** a 1-click cloud deployment and teardown control center inside the Admin Dashboard
**So that** I can spin up a fully functional cloud backend (Azure/AWS) on demand that seamlessly auto-connects to the Vercel frontend without manual intervention or configuration.

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given an authenticated admin on the Vercel frontend, when navigating to the Admin Deploy view, then they see the cloud target selector (Azure AKS / AWS k3s), current backend health status, and action buttons.
- [x] Given a trigger action on the Deploy view, when the admin clicks 'Deploy Backend', then a GitHub Actions workflow is dispatched and the UI displays a live step-by-step progress tracker.
- [x] Given a successful cloud deployment, when Terraform provisions the public IP, then the Dynamic DNS (DuckDNS/Cloudflare) is automatically updated and the Vercel frontend connects without reloading or manual reconfiguration.
- [x] Given an active cloud deployment, when the admin clicks 'Tear Down Backend' (or auto-teardown timer triggers), then the cloud resources are destroyed via `terraform destroy` returning cloud cost to $0.
- [x] Given the frontend on Vercel, when proxying API requests through `vercel.json` rewrites, then no browser Mixed-Content (HTTP/HTTPS) or CORS errors occur.

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

**Estimate:** 5

## Notes
Enables zero-friction live demonstrations of the Filmpire Microservices portfolio on Vercel while preserving the hard $0 cloud cost rule through automated ephemeral lifecycles.
